hero.quote: “Raw feeding has been annoying since day one. There’s no app that solves the problems I actually need solved – counting how much he really needs to eat, seeing how much he ate, and knowing what the hell is left in the fridge. So I got tired of waiting and made the app myself.”
hero.dog_alt: The dog the app was built for

features.section_subtitle: The pillars the app is built on — a dashboard you arrange yourself, the fridge, the macronutrient overview, and a coach that knows what's in both.
features.f4_desc: Weekly feeding total, macros and each meal on one screen — reorder the modules to put what matters most right up top.
features.f1_title: A coach that knows your fridge
features.f1_desc: Ask what to feed today and the Coach suggests a portion made from exactly what you have at home — respecting the daily limits for bones, organs and muscle meat.
features.f2_title: Nutrition tracked down to the gram
features.f2_desc: Every ingredient has its share of muscle meat, bones, organs and other. Adjust the portion and the overview recalculates instantly.
features.f3_title: Stock you always have at hand
features.f3_desc: Ingredients sorted by type — muscle meat, bones, organs, other — with weights and an overview of what's actually left in the fridge.

calc.label: BARF CALCULATOR
calc.title: How much does your dog eat?
calc.subtitle: Calculated per FEDIAF · body condition correction · micronutrients
calc.step_size_sub: Life stage (puppy / adult / senior) is determined automatically from age.
calc.weight_note: Enter the target weight (not current weight if your dog is over/underweight)
calc.age_note: Age determines life stage and feeding percentage
calc.disclaimer: Results are indicative based on FEDIAF guidelines. Actual needs depend on health status and breed. Weigh puppies weekly and recalculate. Consult a veterinary nutrition specialist.
calc.stage_note_puppy: Percentage is based on current weight and decreases with age. Weigh the puppy every week.
calc.stage_note_adult: Percentage based on size × activity × neuter status matrix.
calc.stage_note_senior: Senior gets the 'Couch potato' rate regardless of activity.
calc.cond_over_sub: Ribs hard to feel, rounded shape
calc.cta_app_title: Track portions directly in the app
calc.cta_app_desc: BarfingApp monitors your stock, calculates macros and alerts you what needs to be used.

coach.title: Coach is online
coach.a: Your fridge covers a 430 g portion. Bones are at 60 % of the daily limit, so I added turkey necks.

food.title: Meal 1
food.about_text: Celery is an excellent source of fibre and vitamins with very few calories. It works well as a supplement to a dog's diet and supports digestion.
